document.cue: Describe a public event that you attended with a lot of other people.

text: I'd like to talk about a free open-air concert that took place in the main square of my city on City Day, about two years ago. I went there with two close friends from university, and we got there early to find a good place, because we expected it to be crowded.

By the evening there must have been over ten thousand people in the square. Local bands played first, and then a famous singer came on stage, and everybody started singing along. The atmosphere was fantastic, with people of all ages dancing, waving flags and filming on their phones. At the end there was a huge firework display above the buildings, which lasted for around fifteen minutes. Afterwards, the streets were so crowded that we decided to walk home instead of taking a taxi, and we ended up chatting with some strangers on the way.

Honestly, I felt a real sense of unity. Normally, in a big city, people hurry past each other without a word, but that night everybody was smiling and sharing the same excitement. I also felt proud of my city, because the event was well organised and safe despite the crowd. Although I'm not usually fond of large crowds, I'd happily go to something similar again. It reminded me how important it is for a community to have occasions when people can simply enjoy time together.
